text: Hello sorry for the long mesage, my stepdaughter is 10 months old and her temprature just came up as 39.9 on the ear thermometer and I am honestly panicking a bit because I havent dealt with her being ill on my own before, her mum is on a night shift and I cant get hold of her. I have both calpol and the baby ibuprofen in the cupboard but I dont know how much to give her for her age or if Im meant to give both or just one, and how long to leave between them? I dont want to get it wrong. Her skin and her lips look there normal colour, I keep checking, so I think thats ok? I just want to know what to give her and whether 39.9 is too high to be dealing with at home. Thank you so much
